narrative.overview: The portfolio begins inside recognisable Figma UI3 while Javier refines the real hero. Present removes the tool and reveals a calm carbon editorial dossier in which interface theatre stays subordinate to Javier and his work.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic UI3 chrome only during the opening.
Carbon, bone-white and muted-brass after Present.
Native scrolling and optional guidance after handoff.
Flat, rule-led compositions instead of generic cards.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Brass is an accent, not a wash. Figma colors never become general brand colors.

rules.name: The Condensed Signature Rule
rules.body: Use the width axis for Javier's name and decisive display moments, not continuous reading.

rules.name: The Flat-After-Present Rule
rules.body: Once Present is active, permanent content should not look like a stack of app cards.

dos: Do keep the opening recognisably Figma UI3 and the final portfolio recognisably Javier.
Do preserve native scroll after Present and resolve instantly for reduced motion.
Do use real portraits and keep fictitious cases and metrics visibly labelled.
Do preserve noindex, nofollow and the existing Sites project until Javier authorises publication changes.
donts: Don't carry Figma chrome into the permanent page shell.
Don't reintroduce neon lime, theme switching, generic card grids or oversized pill systems.
Don't make Snapshot or any later edit mandatory.
Don't publish an unverified reference or present a concept metric as a real result.
